items.title: CoreWeave Cashes in on the AI Gold Rush With a 25% Price Hike, and Customers are Still Lining Up: CRWV Stock Rises 19% (UPDATED)
items.summary: Editor’s Note: The story has been refreshed with the latest market price action and a revised headline. CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) raised prices across its artificial intelligence computing offerings in July and is passing along rising hardware costs to customers, as demand continues to accelerate. A Quarter of Pricing Power CFO Nitin Agrawal told analysts on Tuesday’s earnings call that the increase was “an approximately 25% increase across SKUs in response to the current demand environment.”
